field_overrides.reason: Connery: the saved Lynn district programme description explicitly identifies one-way. The DESE directory's two-way code remains in the frozen evidence and is superseded only for this field selection. This adjudicates already collected sources; no new research.

selection_policy: Keep canonical school/programme/site identities; do not merge names or promote grade-context matches into outcome crosswalks.
Use a field-specific reviewed selection when present, otherwise exact selection-year observations, otherwise undated and latest earlier observations with their original dates and limitations.
Exclude explicitly later school-year evidence from a prior-year selection; retrieval date never establishes policy validity.
Earlier or undated evidence is not a newly observed annual configuration. Continuity confirmation concerns operation, not measured exposure.
Keep allocations at their documented grade/service/language scope; do not reduce a progression to one kindergarten ratio or assign campus-only evidence to every strand.
Distinguish documented, inferred, provisional, conflicting, missing, later-only and not-applicable values.
Chinese remains Chinese unless Mandarin is independently reported; English is never added by inference.
Any K-5 grade makes a campus elementary-containing. Secondary-only campuses remain in the inventory without an elementary entry model.
